concerns.text: Task T014 mandates raising a ValueError if pairwise enthalpy data is missing in 'mendeleev', explicitly forbidding fallbacks. This violates FR-002 ('compute... for every valid entry') and Constitution Principle VI (Integrity of descriptors) by forcing a pipeline crash on missing data rather than implementing the required standard calculation formulas (e.g., Miedema) to ensure coverage of all valid entries.

Tasks T012b and T016b enforce N >= 1000 as a hard failure threshold. FR-001 and SC-001 specify a target of N >= 1000 but a minimum of N >= 500. These tasks silently weaken the spec by rejecting valid datasets that meet the minimum requirement but miss the target, violating the acceptance criteria.

Task T031 implements a Classification F1-score sweep for sensitivity analysis. FR-005 and SC-003 explicitly require reporting 'RMSE variance' (a regression metric) across thresholds or correlation stability. The task replaces the required RMSE variance check with F1 stability, failing to deliver the specific evidence demanded by the spec for the continuous target variable.

Task T024a requires generating a null distribution via 1000 bootstrap resamples to perform a t-test. SC-002 specifies a direct comparison of the model's CV performance against a null model (dummy regressor) with p < 0.05. The task introduces a complex bootstrap methodology not specified in the requirement, altering the statistical test definition and potentially violating the 'measured against the baseline null performance' criterion.

Task T029a implements a static collinearity check (Pearson > 0.8) and a one-time retrain. US-3 acceptance scenario 3 requires analyzing 'correlation stability across a range of parameter perturbations'. The task fails to implement the required perturbation analysis, leaving the robustness verification incomplete.
